data.description:
## Incident Overview

**What happened**: Sprint session on worktree-20260526-205640 with dso.workflow=ci-pr in dso-config.conf ran 7 story merges using merge-story-branch.sh (local mode pattern: direct local merge with DSO-Story-Merge trailers) instead of merge-to-main.sh with STORY_PR_BASE (ci-pr pattern: GitHub PR against session branch).

**Evidence**:
- git log shows 'Merge story/115c-3e30-ab7d-4b12/...' commits with local merge patterns
- gh pr list --base worktree-20260526-205640 returns no PRs (no story-level PRs were created)
- mode-detect.sh returns ci-pr
- dso-config.conf contains dso.workflow=ci-pr

**Expected**: In ci-pr mode, Phase F Step 18 should route story merges through merge-to-main.sh with STORY_PR_BASE=$SESSION_BRANCH, creating GitHub PRs from story branches against the session branch.

**Actual**: Story merges used merge-story-branch.sh (local mode), producing direct local merges without GitHub PRs.

**code_version**: 953b4d5cb28f29979fdd184b3ab342c59a276de6
data.title: [sprint-story-merge]: ci-pr mode detected but merge-story-branch.sh (local mode) used for story merges -> stories bypass GitHub PR flow
